Oct 2025 • Couples

Great food, excellent service — highly recommend!

Food
Jul 2025 • Friends
This place has a nice ambience: cozy, welcoming, and beautifully decorated with a lot of attention to detail. It's the kind of spot where you can sit back, relax, and enjoy a good meal. The staff speak good English, which made everything smooth and pleasant.

As for the food, everything we tried was flavorful and well-prepared. You can really taste the effort that goes into each dish. Personally, I think the pineapple fried rice is a must-try. It's not my first time having pineapple fried rice, but this one stood out - the rice had those slightly crispy bits, it added such a nice texture, so good.

Overall, it was a lovely dining experience. Highly recommended if you're looking for a place with great vibes and delicious food

A place with history
Oct 2024 • Couples
Before we knew anything we went there because it had good reviews. They really give you a lot of food, very good and they are very nice.
At the end of the dinner the owner of the place handed us a token where he told his story of how he was a child with nothing and went through many hardships until he decided to become an entrepreneur of his food place. This person today helps children who are currently in the same situation that he was in. A place to go, eat and talk a little with the owner of your story. Highly recommended.

Amazing meal
Sep 2024 • Couples
The Bun Cha is the best we've had in Vietnam, so much flavour and wow do they deliver on food quantity. He recommends one starter (bun cha) and one main course for 2 people. The portions are incredible and so tasty. We got the half roast duck and was amazing. The owner is so kind and his story is inspiring. He donates 100m dong per year to a charity that helped him get to where he is today. It was 400k for both dishes and they gave us so much extra food that we didn't realise was part of the dishes. We have pretty big appetites but we were blown away by the meal we were served.
